citation: Collenteur et al. (2019). Pastas: open source software for the analysis of groundwater time series. https://doi.org/10.1111/gwat.12925
description: Pastas is the open-source Python package maintained by the Pastas team for processing, simulating and analysing groundwater time series. It combines observation series with stress-response components and provides calibration, visualization and statistical analysis. Inputs include measured groundwater heads and explanatory series such as precipitation and evaporation; outputs include fitted groundwater responses, model results and diagnostic plots. Geographic coverage is configurable, with temporal detail determined by the observation and stress series. Public source, examples and Python installation are free under MIT. A limitation is that the selected response functions and calibration data determine the interpretation of groundwater behaviour; a fitted time-series model is not a spatial groundwater-flow model. The package can test water-supply and groundwater-management scenarios and complement MODFLOW-based work such as the agricultural-water-use package (model-modflow-api-agricultural-water-use-package). Its README includes a recharge-model example and cites the 2019 Groundwater paper. Related data-management tools are separate packages. No groundwater measurements, external datasets or model outputs were downloaded.
